$comment: The event streams an extension can subscribe to (cmux.events.on, cmux.live). An event is an invalidation with no payload: the app reads again. The daemon delivers a stream only to an app that may call its `reads` op (apps/subscriptions.rs stream_readable), so that op's scope is the stream's scope. tools/gen-cmux-global.ts checks each `reads` against the catalog and writes the SDKs' table (cmux-extension-sdk/api.json); cmux-tui-core's routing tests check that every stream the daemon publishes is listed here.

workspace.changed.docs: A workspace was created, closed, renamed, reordered, selected or restyled.

pane.changed.docs: A pane was split, closed, resized or focused.

tab.changed.docs: A tab was opened, closed, moved or selected.

terminal.changed.docs: A terminal started, ended or changed its title or folder.

agent.changed.docs: An agent's state changed (working, blocked, idle, done).

agent_chat.changed.docs: An agent chat was added, closed, renamed, read or changed state.

chat.changed.docs: A listed field of an agent chat changed (state, title, unread, pin, step, pull requests); not fired for updated_ms alone.

settings.changed.docs: A cmux setting changed (cmux-next.json, a managed layer, Settings, the CLI or an agent). Read the keys you use again with settings.get; the event names none and carries no values.

theme.changed.docs: The theme changed: the theme, app theme, theme file, theme edits, accent, hue, saturation or highlight color. Theme tones (cmux.theme) repaint on their own; read settings.get again for anything you derive from them.
